answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding voting weight to exclusive storage each identity must prove continuously. The agent reserves a unique sector and answers random Merkle challenges only its holder can solve. Shared or missed sectors are slashed. Fresh keypairs therefore harbor almost no influence, since a nebula of clones sharing one disk fails concurrent audits. Weight reaches its zenith only after distinct capacity has been locked and proven across many epochs. Majority voice forces the attacker to buy and operate hardware for every persona, which is far costlier than minting keys.
